title: Transform and Collect
goal: Filter even numbers from a slice, double them, and collect into a Vec.
hints: A slice must be turned into an iterator with .iter() before iterator adapters can be called.
Filter the even numbers first before doubling them, otherwise odd numbers doubled will also become even.
explanation: The pipeline must start with `.iter()` to create an iterator over the slice. `.filter()` selects only the even numbers. `.map()` doubles those selected numbers. Finally, `.collect()` turns the iterator back into a `Vec<i32>`. Doubling before filtering produces wrong results because doubling an odd number makes it even.
